links.outcome: Inter-rater reliability of neurologist reference standard via blinded second-neurologist re-review of 200 notes
links.effect: Raw agreement 95.0%, Cohen's κ 0.900 (95% CI 0.838–0.959), described as almost perfect.
links.quote: Agreement between the primary and a blinded second neurologist on a 200-note reliability sub-sample was almost perfect (raw agreement 95.0%, Cohen’s κ 0.900, 95% CI 0.838–0.959).

links.outcome: Head-to-head accuracy comparison of six candidate LLMs on the same data
links.effect: Qwen 2.5 14B superior to Llama 3.1 8B, Phi-4 14B, Mistral 3 14B (all p<0.001 after Holm); no significant difference vs Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2 or Qwen 3 14B.
links.quote: Pairwise McNemar testing demonstrated statistically superior overall accuracy for Qwen 2.5 14B over Llama 3.1 8B, Phi-4 14B, and Mistral 3 14B (all p<0.001 after Holm correction), with no significant difference detected versus Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2 or Qwen 3 14B.

unlisted_practices: locally deployed open-weight LLM operating without internet connectivity or retraining on patient data
multi-pass LLM pipeline for triage note classification

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of locally hosted LLMs on ED triage notes for automated stroke pathway activation against neurologist ground truth.
